title: Metadata visualization shows table key not relationship key for relationships
author: frances-h

comments.author: npatki
comments.body:
### Expected Behavior
In the above case, we expect that the edge should be listed as `fk --> other` instead of what it currently is labeled (`fk -- pk`). This edge should be based on what the `'relationships'` section of the metadata has.

Note that within the parent table, the primary key should remain as `pk`. That should be based on what the `'tables'` part of the metadata has.

So we expect that the visualization should showcase the discrepancy (the edge would be marked differently than the primary key in the table).
